strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Match-winning impact
strengths.coach: Man of the Match. The game noticed, and so did I.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 2 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 17/25 passes (68%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

weaknesses.detail: 25 passes but no key passes - plenty of the ball, little going forward
weaknesses.title: Playing forward
tips: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

players.headline: Outstanding midfielder performance (8.6, top 10% for the position) - best at on-ball involvement, goal threat; work on defensive work rate, forcing passes.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Well, BellyTb1, a 8.6 is the kind of night you tell your grandkids about. Top 10% of midfielders, and you earned every bit.
coach.closer: That's the stuff. Same time next match?

push.title: W 4-2 vs Trotted On | You: 8.6 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, that 8.6 is the kind of night that makes an old coach believe in magic. Top 10% of midfielders.

DID WELL
+ 25 passes. You were the busiest person on the pitch. I'm tired just watching.
+ A brace against Trotted On, your 2nd straight match scoring. The net said thank you, and so do I.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. Put that one on the fridge.
+ 0.6 over your norm. Keep stacking days like this.
+ 3 shots on target kicked in +0.1. Small hinges swing big doors.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Coach's secret: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- 68% passing (17 of 25). Next match: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
- No key passes from 25 passes. Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- You and tuxedo_slide, same defensive work rate homework. Partners: pass runners off and track them into the box.

This week's homework: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.

Keep that up and I'll have to start buying bigger biscuit tins. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 54% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 11 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

players.headline: Strong midfielder performance (8.4, top 25% for the position) - best at goal threat, chance creation; work on passing accuracy, on-ball involvement.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: tuxedo_slide, a 8.4. That's top-25% midfielder work, and it didn't happen by accident.
coach.closer: Proud of you. Now go drink some water.

push.title: W 4-2 vs Trotted On | You: 8.4 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.4 against Trotted On. That's top-25% midfielder work, and it didn't happen by accident.

DID WELL
+ A brace against Trotted On, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's the stuff they write songs about. Bad songs, but songs.
+ 1 key pass. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ You and BellyTb1 linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ 3 shots on target: +0.1. Like finding a twenty in last winter's coat.
+ Stack that 8.4 against every midfielder out there: top 25%.

WORK ON
- 54% passing (6 of 11). If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
- Only 11 passes. Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Between you and me: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
- defensive work rate snagged you and BellyTb1 both. Buddy system: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Coach's drill: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs Trotted On | You: 7.3 (above average FOR)
push.body:
A 7.3, PhogsToffees. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

DID WELL
+ 1 key pass. You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ BellyTb1 scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.
+ 4-2 over Trotted On. Winning's like a good porch swing: easy to get used to.

WORK ON
- No shots. Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.
- 72% passing (23 of 32). When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- BellyTb1 had the same forcing passes trouble. Team up on it: give each other short options.
- 0.7 below your usual rating. One match doesn't define you. We go again.

Practice this: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.

Tomorrow's a fresh pitch. Let's go make some divots. - Coach Lasso

talk.opener: That's a W. 4-2 against Trotted On, and I'm smiling so big it hurts.
